method: Required six actual viewport PNG inspected visually by root. No compositing/stitching, DOM content edits or hidden navigation. Additional 320px and selected mobile Translator images inspected too.
checks: Hero: graphite, layered aluminium, red focal accents and readable title/CTA.
Desktop map: all six connected nodes, central selected role and visible truthful development/prototype/planned labels.
Expanded Tax and Translator: existing content and actions legible without nested scroll or overlap.
Mobile: hero and staggered ecosystem remain within viewport; role details expand in natural document flow.
limitations: Local Chromium viewport emulation; owner visual acceptance and physical device QA not claimed.
